abstract: The morphological appearance, incidence and prognostic significance of human chorionic gonadotrophin (HCG)-containing cells in seminomas were examined in a retrospective series of 228 orchidectomy specimens, obtained between 1958 and 1972. Sections from each tumour were stained with haematoxylin and eosin (H & E) and immunocytochemically for HCG. In 33 (14.5%) of the tumours HCG-containing cells were observed, but in only 12 were these recognised in an initial study of the H & E stained sections. HCG staining was seen predominantly in syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells and rarely in "mulberry" cells and mononuclear seminoma cells. Of the patients whose tumours included HCG-containing cells 23% died of their disease within 2 years of orchidectomy, compared with only 8% of the patients whose tumours lacked this feature. It is concluded that immunocytochemical staining for HCG should form part of the routine histological assessment of seminomas, and that the presence of HCG-containing cells indicates a more aggressive disease.
abstract_ja: 目的：セミノーマにおけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-hCG)含有細胞の形態、頻度、および予後的意義を検討した。方法：1958年から1972年の間に得られた228例の精巣摘除標本の後方視的連続症例を、ヘマトキシリン・エオジン染色と免疫細胞化学的β-hCG染色で検討した。結果：腫瘍の14.5%（33例）でβ-hCG含有細胞が認められたが、最初のH&E染色標本で認識されたのはわずか12例であった。β-hCG染色は主に合胞体栄養膜巨細胞に認められ、まれに「桑実状」細胞や単核のセミノーマ細胞にも認められた。β-hCG含有細胞を伴う腫瘍の症例では、精巣摘除後2年以内に23%が原病で死亡したが、含有しない腫瘍の症例では8%であった。結論：セミノーマの日常的な組織学的評価にはβ-hCGの免疫細胞化学染色を含めるべきであり、β-hCG含有細胞の存在はより侵襲性の高い疾患を示す。
